decisions.reason: Although it fits the established industrial business and carries sunk engineering across several models, its lower strategic visibility and two years without website presence make management more willing by 2022 to reallocate resources to core operations and newer ventures.

As a flagship product with its own page and strong public linkage to the firm's direction, management is likely to keep backing it and interpret weak visibility as a temporary commercialization issue rather than grounds for exit.

Because this flagship-direction technology remains closely tied to the firm's sustainability narrative and prior commitment, management is still inclined to persist, though the extended absence from the website raises withdrawal risk more than for Product C.
